decisions.reason: The decorative carpet still has its own product page and fits the core rug offer, and two years is too short to rule out a normal ramp-up, so the firm's visible commitment favours keeping it.
The carpet remains close to the established collection, and any weak results can still be put down to temporary ramp-up effects, so management persists with the investment it has made.
The corner bench extends the core furniture range for residential and hospitality projects, and its development cost and public presentation justify continuing with it.
The low-pile carpet costs little to keep in the portfolio and is publicly presented, so the firm continues it despite having trimmed the rug range once already.
As a multi-model chair line with heavy tooling and design investment that fits the firm's living and working direction, the swivel shell chair is a strongly committed course the firm will keep.
